title: SMPUltimate
body:
This is the ultimate plugin for any SMP!

# Requirements

**THIS PLUGIN REQUIRES PROTOCOL LIB, YOU CAN FIND IT HERE:** [protocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)

# Purpose

I want to make a plugin thats for every minecraft server that can be easily accessible and always free!

# Commands:

/stuck, if a player is in the nether and they are on the roof, they can use /stuck and it'll teleport them down to the flood

/showScore, tied in with the player scoreboard, this command will either show or hide the scoreboard

# Extra Features

This plugin will allow players to spawn in a 10,000 x 10,000 area of spawn (will be customizable soon!), it will also have a nice scoreboard for players to show them their kills and deaths!

# Coming Soon!

- Customization for everything
- Auction House

# What it does

This server will access files to store local player data and will show a scoreboard for players on the center-right of the screen, finally it allows players to spawn in random positions across the map, more features coming soon!
